highlightsParams.query: Context.dev was part of the Y Combinator S26 accelerator batch.

passages:
[We raised $9M to give agents the internet]

Today I get to share some big news: **Context.dev has raised a $9M seed round, led by General Catalyst.**

…

[We raised $9M to give agents the internet > Why I started this]

I started Brand.dev, the company that became Context.dev, with one simple, stubborn idea: **any developer, anywhere in the world, should be able to build software that understands the world it's serving.** An app should know who it's talking to. A product should greet a new customer with their own logo and colors instead of a blank form.

…

[We raised $9M to give agents the internet > What changed along the way]

An agent is only as good as the context it has. A brilliant model that can't see the web is guessing. That's when it clicked for me: what we had been building all along was Context. Earlier this year Brand.dev became Context.dev, and our job got a lot clearer: **give agents the internet.**

Today teams use Context.dev to keep data on more than 20 million companies fresh, to power 3,000+ integrations, to give Similarweb's AI agents the datapoints they need, to build a 2M+ food and supplement database, and to ship an onboarding MVP in an hour. Along the way we joined Y Combinator and launched Highlights so agents spend their tokens on the parts of a page that matter.

…

[We raised $9M to give agents the internet > Related articles.]

- Oct 20, 2026 **Introducing news search** Search over 200 million articles for company announcements, press releases, and news. Give your agents current sources to work with.

- May 31, 2026 **We're now backed by YCombinator** A quick note from Yahia: Context.dev is now backed by Y Combinator.

- Sep 28, 2026 **Introducing Context Highlights** Token-efficient web extraction for agents. Context Highlights returns the relevant passages from a webpage for your query.
